title: Check every backend command against a permission list: declare the app's own commands and grant them to its windows
story: Maestro now checks every call a window makes to its backend against a list of allowed commands; before, calls to the app's own commands were not checked at all. The main, issue-map and Work Journal windows keep every command they had, so nothing should look or behave differently.

checks.criterion: The main window loads and no app command is refused
checks.steps: Install the build from main, start Maestro and open a sample project folder.
checks.expected: The sidebar, terminals and Settings work as before, with no error toast.

checks.steps: Open a sample GitHub repository, then open the issue map from the Git panel.
checks.expected: The map window opens and loads issues, and its filters work.

checks.criterion: The Work Journal window still works
checks.steps: Turn on Work Journal in Settings, then pop the journal out into its own window.
checks.expected: The window opens and shows its pages, and you can add and edit a made-up entry.
